_about: Needles: one short, distinctive literal string per hard-won fact absorbed into the
plugin artifacts. `scripts/check-needles.py` asserts each one is present SOMEWHERE in
the corpus (plugins/**/*.md). Presence is asserted corpus-wide, never per file, so
content is free to move between artifacts — that is the point: the gate proves a fact
survived a restructure, it does not freeze the layout.
Adding a needle: pick a phrase that could only survive if the FACT survives — a coined
term, a literal command, a measured number, a distinctive noun phrase. Not a full
sentence (legitimate rewording breaks it) and not a common word (it passes by accident).
Verify it is present before committing; the gate refuses an absent needle.
Removing a needle: only with the deliberate decision that the fact no longer applies,
recorded in the commit message. A red gate is not a reason to delete the entry.

_fields.needle: Required. The literal substring asserted present in at least one corpus file.
_fields.issue: Originating ai-learning issue number, or null where the absorbing commit closed a batch and the individual attribution is not recoverable.
_fields.commit: The branch commit that absorbed the fact. `git show <sha>` carries the full rationale and the `Closes #…` set — see `_sources`.
_fields.was_in: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — the artifact this needle lived in when it was pinned. Never asserted. A starting point for a search, and expected to go stale as content moves.
_fields.note: Required. One line naming the fact the needle guards, so a red gate teaches instead of just failing.
_fields.file: OPTIONAL and rare. Repo-relative path. Present only where the LOCATION is itself the fact — then the needle must appear in that exact file. Do not add it to make a needle 'more precise'; it defeats the corpus-wide design.

needles.needle: ## 1 — A verdict is evidence only about what it actually executed
needles.note: Fact 1's heading. File-pinned deliberately: six artifacts cite it as '§1', so the numbered section is an addressable anchor and may not migrate.

needles.needle: ## 3 — An inherited statement is a claim with a provenance and an expiry
needles.note: Fact 3's heading. File-pinned for the same reason as fact 1 — verify-build and design-multi cite '§3' by number.

needles.needle: a gate states its blind spot in the same breath as its verdict
needles.note: The rule fact 1 exists to state: 'green' with no named blind spot is a claim, not a result.

needles.needle: a negative result is evidence only if the probe could have produced a positive
needles.note: The positive-control corollary — every absence claim (zero callers, nothing drifted) ships with something the probe must flag.
Why reassuring-failing checks ('no errors in ten minutes, therefore green') are the ones that need a positive control.

needles.needle: An unspecified seam adjacent to a specified one
needles.note: Fact 4 — the highest-risk place in a design, because the specified rule is exactly what gets reused in the gap.
A run that executed nothing exits 0. Inconclusive, never green, never a baseline. Restated by test-runner and verify-build.

needles.needle: stops parsing options at the first operand
needles.note: Probe hygiene: BSD getopt turns a trailing `--include` into a filename — prints nothing, exits 0, no stderr.
/start emits the baseline itself; without it every later step re-derives the base's pre-existing failures (fleet lanes, in parallel).
The measurement behind 'capture the baseline on a freshly built tree' — unresolved .d.ts cascades into ordinary-looking type errors.
A predicate claimed single-source-of-truth must fail one test per declared consumer; a shortfall means a second inline copy exists.
Set `passes: true` in the same turn as the commit — one lane sat on six committed slices with a state file reading slicesDone: 1.
Bash backgrounds a gate at the 600 s ceiling against your instruction; a subagent awaiting a backgrounded job deadlocks permanently.
An assertion reading PATH/HOME/TZ/locale/git-config has a verdict that is a property of who ran it.

needles.needle: Never negative-test a guard by mutating tracked files
needles.note: Prove a guard fails on bad input in a throwaway scratch dir — never end a turn with a deliberate mutation in the tree.

needles.needle: "none" is a valid answer, the field is not
needles.note: The executor's issues/deviations field is required output — it is routed verbatim into the verifier and is the cheapest defect-catch in the flow.
A load-flaky failure untouched by the slice's diff is an environment artifact, named as such — not a slice RED that triggers executor churn.
All three agents stop asking for a relay: the dispatching agent reads their return value directly. Present in executor, verifier and test-runner.

needles.needle: PASS-with-follow-ups is not available for a named mitigation
needles.note: A finding leaving a design-named mitigation unverified is RETRY, not a follow-up — parking it silently un-mitigates a consciously accepted risk.
A background wake arrives wrapped in an unsuppressable platform refusal; a text-review pass passes the design and the mechanism deadlocks.
The falsification table — the verifier's required output shape, covering the design docs' claims and not only the diff's.
Quote symbols as the source spells them — a paraphrased identifier is indistinguishable from a real one until you grep.
State what a count counts, never 'five call sites'. Restated in design-multi and EVIDENCE §3.
Check the mechanism behind a ticket's rationale: a package 'blocked on publishing 1.4.0' had never been published at any version.

needles.needle: prose fitting is not the claim being true
needles.note: The second pass verifies a resolved block's reasoning, not that its cited sites still read as quoted — zero drift reads as nothing to check.
The design-doc section name that /plan and /build consume as explicit non-guidance. A section nobody emits is a silence that gets generalized.

needles.needle: could a fresh session holding only this repo
needles.note: Step 4's self-containment gate — a step may not hand off state living only in its own context, and this fails worse the better the session was.

needles.needle: no user to approve, by construction
needles.note: /plan's unattended branch — a literal reading of the human-review gate stalls every fleet lane at this step.
/design-multi greps for its own past output before dispatching — the one command guaranteed to meet its own work, and otherwise blind to it.

needles.needle: The emit precedes the critique deliberately
needles.note: critique's terminal-looking verdict outcompetes a trailing 'then emit'; two of three agents once ended their turn with no files written.
A task-completion notification is never evidence the agent produced anything — stat the files from disk before collecting a unit.
The third state beyond apply-or-skip for a glossary/ADR delta describing code that has not landed yet.
Three lanes once picked the same ADR number: different filenames, no conflict, clean merge. The orchestrator allocates, lanes never self-number.
The :v2 resolved-block readiness field. Without it an unattended lane picks up a deferred/blocked/umbrella unit and may open a bad PR.
A two-parent merge is the orchestrator's, not the child's — a base that does not compile surfaces its failures deep inside the child.
A reused worktree's .work/ is archived, not deleted: those buffers hold the learnings.md that step 6 exists to rescue.
Compute base-sensitive recon against the pinned BASE, never a working-dir grep whose HEAD has drifted from it.
Size --max-parallel by memory, not cores: past some N the fleet falls off a cliff, not a slope (95 s alone vs >38 min under load).
Address every message from agents.yaml, never from recall — reconstructing the map from dispatch order misrouted two corrections in one run.

needles.needle: terminal state and a positive control
needles.note: A stall detector without a terminal state cries wolf exactly when the run is going well, and gets muted right before it would have been useful.

needles.needle: Failed to resolve entry for package
needles.note: 'install' is not 'ready' — workspace deps resolve through a gitignored build/, so a fresh worktree needs a build before any agent is dispatched.
A child cut at build-complete is stranded on a base its parent then fixes; record the tip and forward-merge after the parent's verify-build.
A directive carries the constraint, never the expression — this one was implemented faithfully and double-billed a metering period.
Mechanical-guard sweep: enumerate every surface that can set the dispatch field. A sibling MCP surface forwarded it and disarmed the guard.

needles.needle: 72 lines below a line the PR had just fixed
needles.note: Claim-correction sweep: sweep the belief in synonyms, and re-sweep every file the PR itself edited — a self-contradicting file is worse than neither fix.
Merge-ripple sweep: new files conflict with nothing, so they appear in no conflict list — an added oracle merged green and tested nothing.
A green *partial* inventory reads as full coverage — compare the runner's reported file count against the repo's test files on disk.
A stacked child keeps pointing at a merged branch; merging it there returns exit 0, shows MERGED, and delivers nothing to the default branch.
A control byte in a source literal makes git call the file binary — grep returning nothing on a file you just edited is the earlier tell.
critique's input contract: hand the lenses verified facts, not a summary. Restatement means the input was too abstract, not that the design was sound.
The no-ADRs-yet default must match what vertical-slicing and verify-build render; it fires once per repo and sets a convention forever.
Proposed node ids do not derive the way extracted ones do — read the returned nodeIds instead of guessing a whole batch correctly.
The grill probe for any design leaning on a background task's exit re-invoking a session — it must explicitly disarm the platform refusal.
A recorded agentId dies with its session — which is precisely the situation a handoff exists to serve. Carry what a fresh dispatch needs.

needles.needle: gate that never fired is indistinguishable from a gate that cannot fire
needles.note: Order a self-enforcing slice so a later slice in the same PR is its first live subject. Also stated in verify-build step 4.
`onStarted` is not a queue: under the start-first boot order a bare `if (draining) return` silently drops every declaration after the first.
A complete-state projector write needs replace; the default merge can add and overwrite but never delete a key.
MemoryDb's upsert takes no options argument at all, so it silently ignores replace — the harness cannot even express the bug.
A new PolicyBuilder policy emits an internal operation route with no HTTP surface, and generate-all fails hard until it has a capability entry.
Drive a standalone cron poll policy through a real cron tick; a bare pollFn(ports) call dispatches a command that never reaches the pipeline.

needles.needle: dedup per-stream on version, NEVER on global position
needles.note: The one dedup rule: a global position high-water mark drops exactly the gap-recovered events, silently re-creating a dropped-event bug.
The dedup key is a per-stream last-applied version watermark; per-stream order makes it sufficient, so no consumer needs to remember every event id.
A skipped duplicate must still answer 2xx — an error makes the outbox retry it forever (retry storm) instead of setting the dispatched bit.
The four duplicate causes (a)-(d): crash-before-SETBIT, lost HTTP response, operator replay, and the unfenced cross-process owner that only appears after scale-out.

needles.needle: iff the dispatched bit was already set
needles.note: The exact definition of event.metadata.isRedelivery — true only where the outbox is re-sending an already-committed position, i.e. only operator replay.
isRedelivery is never set on a genuine first delivery, which is what makes suppressing an effect on it safe — and it is silent on the crash/retry paths.
A non-idempotent external effect needs the watermark committed atomically with it, or its own idempotency key; isRedelivery does not replace that work.
Guard order at the boundary: isRedelivery-skip first, then B/C dedup — isRedelivery is a no-op precisely on the crash-window duplicate, which is version > watermark.
The A/B/C layer model's B layer: a durable event.id-keyed checkpoint, distinct from the aggregate invariant (A) and the reconcile-by-natural-key (C).
Partial-progress redelivery: seed `remaining` from the source aggregate's recorded progress, never by re-walking live downstream balances.
The soft-delete trap: stateExists() does not protect a soft-deleted aggregate, so a terminal command re-emits its event on redelivery.
A blind processed-events ledger is justified only when the external effect is both non-idempotent AND non-reconcilable; otherwise reconcile by natural key.
Plain atomicIncrement is not redelivery-idempotent; an accumulating cross-stream counter needs a deterministic-id contribution ledger and delta-only increments.
Brand-new-row bootstrap: identity-only upsert plus per-field CAS init with op:'notExists' — a skeleton-of-zeros upsert loses a racing increment.

needles.needle: operator does not exist: text @> jsonb
needles.note: An array-of-string field queried with op:'contains' needs { strategy: 'gin' }; the default strategy materializes a text column and fails at runtime.
`.produces([])` crashes endpoint registration; a side-effect-only command declares one possible event and returns [] from the handler.
At-most-one-in-flight is a UNIQUE-constraint side-write acquired in the command transaction and released by every terminal handler — a missed one is the stuck-lock bug.
The safe contrast to persisted-field renames: PV3 derives stream/route/subscription identity from the filename, so renaming code symbols is safe. Do not over-apply the rule.
ddd-patterns is a hub plus six references; the trigger table is what gets the pointer followed. Lose it and six files are orphaned with nothing erroring.

needles.needle: A closing keyword binds to exactly one
needles.note: GitHub closes only the first issue after each Closes keyword. `Closes #56 #62 #63` closed #56 and left the rest open — 80 referenced issues became 7 closures and 73 stragglers, with the PR MERGED and CI green. Fails in the reassuring direction; the only tell is a backlog count.
